answer: A quartz-keyed admission system gives every agent one credential bound to a hardware enclave. A second clone must first post a delta bond of 400 credits held for 90 epochs, so the capital tied up scales as 400*n epoch-units for n identities. Each epoch a gale sampler re-checks 10 percent of enclave attestations against signed nonce receipts; any duplicate loses its whole bond, which makes bulk registration unprofitable.
